column2:
Humanity has regained the initiative on Kwalasha. The Bug hordes have been driven out of the capital and will be kept out of the industrial heartland through a solid barrier of fortifications.

The last section of this ambitious perimeter is about to be completed as the Mobile Infantry reclaims an abandoned line of defenses and gun batteries.
Do not lose any SAM Site

column2: Bugs on the run?  Feels like this fight isn't quite over yet.
People at home need hope.  FedNet tells them what they have to hear to keep them fighting.
The perimeter will have to be retaken and its heavy weapons made operational.
That's not happening until we've cleared this rear area of bugs.  Then we'll push up and get those guns firing.
Thanks for the heads up.  We'll use the Perimeter's turrets to stop them.  Nothing's getting past those bad boys once they're up and running.
Excellent work. The perimeter is secure.  The remnants of the Arachnid forces are retreating into the desert.
As expected, the Bugs don’t relent so readily. Large numbers are closing on your position.
Looks they want to test the strength of these Wavebreakers. We’ll be ready for them.
Hold the perimeter, or the green zone is going to turn red real fast.
